title: The Future Siege | ECHO//100 Episode 86
description: Kavi faces his own future self while the city crumbles into a literal void. The timeline fractures as the Door War reaches a point of no return. Episode 86 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction series.

scenes.text: Future Kavi fires a beam of pure silence, vaporizing the plaza floor beneath them.
scenes.caption: Silence vaporizes ground
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie and glasses stands on crumbling pavement as a beam of void-energy strikes, vertical cinematic style.

scenes.text: He claims killing his younger self remains the only way to stabilize the broken timeline.
scenes.caption: Future self attacks
scenes.image_prompt: Future Kavi, scarred and wearing tattered gear, aims a glowing weapon at young Kavi, vertical composition.

scenes.text: Byte and Null merge, their combined light blinding the sensors of the encroaching rift.
scenes.caption: Byte and Null merging
scenes.image_prompt: White floating Byte and black glitch-entity Null fusing into a singular orb of cyan and red light.

scenes.text: Systemic collapse pulses through Kavi’s veins, turning the future version into a hollow puppet.
scenes.caption: Systemic collapse revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Future Kavi's eyes glowing with jagged digital corruption, veins pulsing with static, vertical perspective.

scenes.text: The epicenter of the Door War rots him from within, demanding total, immediate erasure.
scenes.caption: War eats the future
scenes.image_prompt: A massive swirling rift in the sky behind Future Kavi, leaking geometric debris, vertical wide shot.

scenes.text: Kavi drops the weapon, realizing the future self is already a dead, hollow shell.
scenes.caption: The bitter reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring in horror at his future self, who stands motionless and resigned to total non-existence.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches into the backpack, retrieving the glowing red shard, the only unstable variable.
scenes.caption: The red shard
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's hand gripping a jagged, vibrating red crystal, focus on the lens flare.

scenes.text: Kavi hurls the shard into the rift, watching reality fold into an impossible shape.
scenes.caption: Reality folds inward
scenes.image_prompt: The city landscape bending like origami, buildings overlapping into strange geometry, vertical cinematic view.
